abyss_deer.name: Abyss deer
abyss_deer.appearance: The creature is about 1 block wide, 2 blocks long, and 2 blocks tall. It has a tall narrow deer-like shape with a raised neck, slim body, long snout, and large branching antlers. The head shows side ears, a dark face, a forward snout, and paired antlers with multiple upward and outward tines. The body is mostly black and very dark teal with a long rectangular torso, thin neck, small tail, and four slim legs. The legs end in pale hoof blocks. The colour pattern is black with bright cyan-blue stripes on the torso, legs, face, and antlers.
facts: They eat grass only in pairs.
Herd circles calm nervous young deer.

amethyst_scarab.name: Amethyst scarab
amethyst_scarab.appearance: The creature is about 1 block wide, 1 block long, and 0.5 blocks tall. It has a very low beetle-like shape with a flat broad shell and short legs close to the ground. The head is small and partly hidden under the front shell. The body is a compact oval-rectangular carapace made of layered shell plates. The legs are short, dark, and arranged along both sides. The colour pattern is amethyst purple and lilac on the shell, with a dark underside, dark legs, yellow mandible-like front parts, and small pale highlights.

axolotl_dragon.name: Axolotl dragon
axolotl_dragon.appearance: The creature is about 10.5 blocks wide, 10.5 blocks long, and 3.5 blocks tall. It has a long horizontal aquatic-dragon shape with a broad spread of side fins or wings and a long segmented tail. The head is square and dragon-like, with a wide snout, dark eyes, visible jaw, pale teeth, and axolotl-like side gill frills. The body is elongated and pink, tapering into a thick tail. The limbs are small compared with the body, while the side fins, gill branches, wing-like panels, and tail dominate the silhouette. The colour pattern is pink, magenta, pale pink, and darker purple-magenta, with muted gray-blue leg details.

cave_dweller.name: Cave dweller
cave_dweller.appearance: The creature is about 0.5 blocks wide, 0.5 blocks long, and 2.5 blocks tall. It has a very thin upright humanoid shape with a narrow torso, long limbs, and a downward-hanging head. The head is elongated and square, tilted forward, with long teeth. The body is pale, slender, and minimally bulky. The arms are very long and hang low beside the body. The legs are long and thin, ending in small feet. The colour pattern is mostly white and light gray, with darker gray details around the face and joints.

ender_ape.name: Ender ape
ender_ape.appearance: The creature is about 1.5 blocks wide, 1.5 blocks long, and 1 block tall. It has a hunched ape-like shape with a compact dark torso and oversized forearms. The head is blocky and purple, with a dark face area and pale pink-purple facial patches. The body sits low and forward, giving it a crouched primate posture. The arms are much larger than the legs, with bulky purple forearms and hands. The legs are shorter and darker. The colour pattern is black and very dark purple on the body, with deep purple arms and head, lavender highlights, and pale pink face accents.
facts: It drums on hollow tree trunks.
Groups solve fights with drum beats.

flying_bunny.name: Flying bunny
flying_bunny.appearance: The creature is about 1.5 blocks wide, 1.5 blocks long, and 2 blocks tall. It has a small rabbit-like body with large upward wing-like appendages that make the silhouette much taller than the body. The head is small and blocky, with a rabbit-like face, dark eye, and short snout. The body is compact and pale tan, with short legs and small feet. The upper appendages rise from the body like large feathered wings or ears. The colour pattern is cream and tan with brown patches, teal-green feathers, yellow-gold feather tips, dark feet, and dark eye details.
facts: Flying helps them look for foxes.

glare.name: Glare
glare.appearance: The creature is about 1 block wide, 1 block long, and 1 block tall. It has a boxy plant-creature shape, like a leafy green cube standing on short legs. The face sits in a dark horizontal slit on the front, with white rectangular eyes and red pupils. The body is a large rectangular block covered in leaf-like panels. The top has small plant sprouts. The legs are short, brown, and trunk-like beneath the leafy body. The colour pattern is olive green and dark green, with brown support legs, white eyes, red pupils, and a dark face opening.
facts: Its name shows how watchful it is.

grand_grassling_father.name: Grand grassling father
grand_grassling_father.appearance: The creature is about 2 blocks wide, 2 blocks long, and 1 block tall. It has a large squat plant-and-soil mound shape with a broad grass-covered top and multiple blocky face masses beneath it. The body is wide and heavy, like a living grassy platform with brown dirt or wood sides. The faces appear as green-brown cuboid blocks under the grass cap, with pale eyes and dark mouth openings. The legs are thick, short, and brown. The top carries grass tufts, small plants, flowers, and leafy growths. The colour pattern is saturated green and brown with white face patches and small red-yellow plant accents. Animation: makes plant growth appear in a circle from the body and ground area.

ice_golem.name: Ice golem
ice_golem.appearance: The creature is about 7.5 blocks wide, 3 blocks long, and 7 blocks tall. It has a huge bulky humanoid-golem shape with broad hunched shoulders, massive arms, heavy legs, and jagged icy protrusions. The head is small relative to the body and partly embedded high in the torso, with dark facial or beard-like markings. The body is wide and pale blue, with a thick chest, large back mass, and dark ragged waist. The arms end in large clawed hands. The legs are thick and heavy. The colour pattern is pale ice blue, turquoise, dark teal, gray-black, and frosty light-blue highlights.
facts: Cold leaks from a stone heart.

killer_crab.name: Killer crab
killer_crab.appearance: The creature is about 1 block wide, 1 block long, and 0.5 blocks tall. It has a low spiky crab-like shape with a compact carapace, many thin legs, and a forward red mouth area. The head and face are merged into the front of the body, with a red jaw-like region and pale tooth-like or eye-like highlights. The body is dark, segmented, and covered with raised spikes or shell plates. The limbs are thin and arranged along both sides, with front pincer-like or jaw-like parts. The colour pattern is black, dark brown, red, pale yellow-white, and tan.

lizard_knight.name: Lizard knight
lizard_knight.appearance: The creature is about 1 block wide, 1 block long, and 2 blocks tall. It has an upright reptilian humanoid shape with a knight-like torso, broad shoulders, and a trailing tail. The head is green and lizard-like, with a protruding snout, dark eyes, and a broad jaw. The body has a humanoid chest with armour-like panels, a belt, and squared shoulders. The arms and legs are blocky, with claw-like hands and feet. The tail extends behind the body. The colour pattern is green reptile skin with brown belt and cuff details, gray-dark armour panels, and teal-green chest accents.

mushroom_bup.name: Mushroom bup
mushroom_bup.appearance: The creature is about 1 block wide, 1 block long, and 1 block tall. It has a very short squat humanoid shape dominated by an oversized mushroom cap. The head is mostly formed by a large red toadstool cap with white square spots. The face is small and partly hidden beneath the cap on a pale stem-like head. The body is compact and white or cream, with stubby arms, short legs, and small rounded feet. The colour pattern is bright red and white on the mushroom cap, with a pale cream body, pale skin accents, and dark facial details.

orc.name: Orc
orc.appearance: The creature is about 2 blocks wide, 1 block long, and 2.5 blocks tall. It has a stocky upright humanoid shape with broad shoulders, thick arms, and a heavy torso. The head is square and green, with a dark brow or hair area, small pale eyes, and side ear-like protrusions. The body is muscular and green, with a wide chest, brown belt, and loincloth-like lower garment. The arms are thick, with brown wrist bands, and the legs are sturdy with blocky feet. The colour pattern is green and dark green, with brown belt and cuff details, pale eye patches, and a light central belt plate.

prototype_warden.name: Prototype warden
prototype_warden.appearance: The creature is about 2 blocks wide, 2 blocks long, and 3 blocks tall. It has a tall pale experimental-creature shape with a vertical sensor head, rectangular torso, and four short blocky legs. The head is upright and rectangular, with a dark vertical sensor-mouth strip and blue-gray side prongs. The body is pale pink-white and boxy, with dark circular or square holes on the front and sides. The limbs are short and blocky, ending in black feet. The side appendages look like small sensor horns or antennae. The colour pattern is pale white, pale pink, black, dark brown, tan, and blue-gray.

retro_tv_robot.name: Retro TV robot
retro_tv_robot.appearance: The creature is about 1 block wide, 0.5 blocks long, and 2.5 blocks tall. It has a small thin machine-creature shape with a CRT television head on a narrow mechanical body. The head is a black rectangular TV casing with a bright cyan-blue screen and small antenna details on top. The body is slim and gray, with thin black supports, small blocky joints, and a narrow base. The limbs are minimal, more like mechanical struts than full arms or legs. The colour pattern is black and dark gray on the casing and supports, cyan-blue on the screen, and gray stone-like blocks on the body. Animation: runs continuously in a mechanical way.

scrambler_king.name: Scrambler king
scrambler_king.appearance: The creature is about 3.5 blocks wide, 5.5 blocks long, and 4 blocks tall. It has a squat robotic monarch shape with a central cube body, raised screen-like head, raised side arms, and short thick legs. The head is an elevated black rectangular monitor-like block with pale vertical striping and a dark central face mark. The body is square and pale mechanical, with a large circular blue-black chest device and red centre. The arms are raised and end in small black screen-like blocks. The legs are short and heavy with dark feet. The colour pattern is pale green-gray, black, dark teal, cream, blue-black, and red.
facts: It speaks through its red chest.
Only one scrambler earns the crown.

walking_robot_guy.name: Walking robot guy
walking_robot_guy.appearance: The creature is about 1 block wide, 1 block long, and 3 blocks tall. It has a slim upright humanoid-robot shape with a narrow torso, long jointed limbs, and a small square head. The head has a gray casing, dark face band, bright cyan-blue eyes, and small red markings. The body is beige-gray and mechanical, with a thin black waist or spine and segmented pelvis. The arms are thin with blocky forearms and hands. The legs are long and segmented with knee joints and rectangular feet. The colour pattern is beige, gray, black, cyan-blue, red, and small yellow accent bands near one lower leg. Animation: runs continuously in a mechanical way.

wardigo.name: Wardigo
wardigo.appearance: The creature is about 3.5 blocks wide, 6.5 blocks long, and 13.5 blocks tall. It has an enormous tall skeletal-monster shape with extremely long limbs, a raised neck, a long rear extension, and large branching antlers. The head is elongated and skull-like, with a long snout, dark face, pale jaw sections, and antlers branching upward and outward. The body is very thin, black, and dark teal, with exposed pale rib-like and spine-like sections. The arms and legs are extremely long and narrow, ending in pale claw or hoof tips. The colour pattern is mostly black and very dark teal, with cyan-blue glowing lines, pale bone-white panels, and bright blue antler accents.
facts: It grew tall because it was fed too much.

instructions_html:
Instructions

General

Each scoring round, you should have the current question element (Q1_name, Q2_fact1, Q2_fact2, Q2_fact3, Q3_looks, Q4_chapter, Q4_env), the current creature (Abyss deer, Amethyst scarab, Axolotl dragon, Cave dweller, Ender ape, Flying bunny, Glare, Grand grassling father, Ice golem, Killer crab, Lizard knight, Mushroom bup, Orc, Prototype warden, Retro TV robot, Scrambler king, Walking robot guy, Wardigo), and standardised answer given.

Based on the current question element and creature, select the right rubric to use. This rubric has three possible scores: 0 (= fully wrong), 1 (= partially correct) , and 2 (= fully correct). You always start comparing the answer to examples for the highest possible score first, and then move down if the answer does not meet these examples. Score each row independently. The same standardised answer may appear for multiple rubrics, but each row should only be scored for the current question element and current creature.

When scoring, focus on content-bearing words rather than non-content words such as ‘I don’t know,’ ‘maybe,’ ‘I think,’ or ‘not sure.’ Do not penalise minor misspellings, typos, plural forms, or grammatical errors when the intended meaning is clear.

Score generously when the intended meaning is clear, but do not infer details that are not present in the answer. The answer does not need to use the exact wording of the rubric examples, unless the current rubric asks for an exact target in terms of wording. The rubric examples will also contain custom components:

  • [SRC]   = Study Relevant Content. Incorrect content that comes from another creature, chapter, place, label, or fact in the study.
  • [FAN]  = Fantasy. Incorrect or unsupported content that was not part of the study, including invented content, vague invented details, fantasy descriptions, or unsupported synonyms.

General answer handling

  • Before scoring, remove non-answer material that would receive score = 0 by itself, such as “I don’t know”, “maybe”, “not sure”, “I think”, or similar hedging. Then score the remaining answer.
  • Do not remove [SRC] or [FAN] content if it is part of the actual answer.
  • If an answer gives multiple genuine candidate answers, score each candidate separately, average the candidate scores, and round upward to the nearest integer in the participant’s favour. Do not use this rule for one answer with added modifiers or interfering additions.
  • For all answers, minor spelling mistakes, typos, plural forms, and obvious misspellings do not reduce the score when the intended meaning is clear.
  • Information from another question element only earns credit when it is relevant to the current rubric. For example, a chapter name alone does not earn credit in a creature-environment rubric, and an environment description alone does not earn credit in a chapter-name rubric.
  • If a rubric row says “At least two targets”, the examples still show one target per line rather than pre-combined pairs. This means graders may freely combine any two proposed targets from that row when deciding whether an answer contains at least two targets.

Question elements (+ examples)

  • “Creature Name”: score the exact creature name in terms of wording. Synonyms, translations, looks, facts, chapters, or environments do not count unless the actual target name is also present.
  • “Creature Facts”: score the semantic target of the current fact only. Other correct facts from the same creature are harmless extras when the current fact target is present, but they do not count as the current fact when the current target is absent.
  • “Creature Looks”: score the semantic visual description of the creature. The creature name, facts, chapter, or environment alone do not count as looks.
  • “Creature Chapter Name”: score the exact chapter name or chapter number. Specific place/environment descriptions alone do not count as chapter names.
  • “Creature Environment”: score the semantic description of the specific place where the creature was found. Chapter names or chapter numbers alone do not count as environment descriptions.
